title: PDF to PowerPoint – Convert PDF to Editable PPTX, No Upload
description: Convert a PDF to PowerPoint in your browser: one slide per page, with editable text boxes and the pictures where they were. Free, nothing is uploaded.
heading: PDF to PowerPoint
subtitle: Turn each page of a PDF into a slide with editable text boxes and its pictures; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert PDF to PowerPoint online to reuse a report or handout in a presentation: every page becomes a slide of the same shape, each block of text an editable text box where it was, and each picture where it sat. Headings keep their size and lists their bullets. Drawn shapes, colours and backgrounds are left out, so the slides are clean to restyle. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Editable slides
features.text: Text boxes you can click into and change, not pictures of pages.

features.title: Pictures kept
features.text: Photos and charts saved as pictures go on the slide where they were.

stepsTitle: How to convert PDF to PowerPoint

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the .pptx file and open it in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides.

handles: One slide per page, the size and shape of the first page.
Text blocks as editable text boxes, with size, bold, italic and bullets.
Arabic text boxes, right to left.
limits: Drawn shapes, lines, colours and backgrounds are left out; only text and pictures come across.
Text boxes use Arial, so lines can wrap a little differently from the PDF.
Scanned PDFs hold pictures of pages, so there is no text to convert (that needs OCR).
PDFs that need a password to open must be unlocked first, with Unlock PDF.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can I edit the text on the slides?
faq.answer: Yes. Every block of text is a normal PowerPoint text box.

faq.question: Why are some shapes or backgrounds missing?
faq.answer: Only text and pictures are carried over; drawn shapes, lines and backgrounds are left out, so the slides can be restyled.

faq.question: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: No. A scanned PDF holds pictures of pages, so there is no text to convert; that needs text recognition (OCR), which this tool does not do.

faq.question: I need the pages exactly as they look. What can I use?
faq.answer: PDF to JPG saves each page as a picture you can put on a slide.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
